serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:575.96pt;position:var(--position);white-space:pre;width:2.5pt"> </span></div><div style="line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);text-align:justify;text-align-last:var(--justify);top:539.9pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', gas and electricity), which have historically been volatile.</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:575.83pt;position:var(--position);white-space:pre;width:2.5pt"> </span></div><div style="line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);text-align:justify;text-align-last:var(--justify);top:551.9pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', determined by workforce size, and shipping and handling costs,</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:575.92pt;position:var(--position);white-space:pre;width:2.5pt"> </span></div><div costs. Additionally, for corrugated and consumer packaging</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',
